target.title: fix: stop model catalog sidecar read/write races
target.body:
Closes #99390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway/model catalog readers could observe plugin catalog sidecar directories while the model catalog writer was updating them, causing `FsSafeError: directory changed during operation` warnings and retry loops during provider model discovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing `models.json` write serialization now also protects reads that depend on the same `models.json` plus generated plugin catalog sidecar snapshot. The fix keeps the coordination inside the agent model catalog owner boundary and does not add config, migrations, or provider-specific policy.

## User Impact

Operators should no longer see the model catalog reader race the generated sidecar writer and loop on directory-change warnings while provider catalog sidecars are being refreshed. Read-only model catalog browsing waits for the in-process write to finish, then reads a stable persisted catalog snapshot.

## Evidence

Current head: `2dbe0363cb9e4f9982afd1460e7a50a9435e6b7e`.

- Claim proved: the ClawSweeper lint finding is fixed, and the focused regression still proves that read-only persisted model catalog loading waits for an in-process `models.json` / plugin catalog sidecar write before reading sidecar rows.
- Commands / artifacts:
  - `node_modules\.bin\oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts`
  - `git diff --check`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-core.config.ts src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts --reporter=verbose -t "waits for model catalog sidecar writes before reading persisted plugin rows"`
- Observed result:
  - Touched-file oxlint passed after changing the Promise executor to use a block body.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
  - Focused Vitest passed: 1 test passed, 53 skipped.
- Earlier supporting evidence from this PR:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 66 tests.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-model-catalog.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 12 tests.
  - Touched-file `oxfmt --check` passed on the model-catalog files.
- Not tested / proof gaps:
  - No live Anthropic gateway proof is attached from this environment because `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is not available in the local process.
  - The focused regression proves the read/write coordination at the changed source boundary; it does not show a redacted live gateway log where the originally reported Anthropic/provider-catalog warning loop stops.
